turns.replyText:
Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.

Got it, love that you are aiming for smart value, not just lowest price. Based on what you are seeing now, here are two great “bang for your buck” options and how they compare:

Everyday workhorse top
Men’s Timmons Mock-Neck Scrub Top – Navy
Why it is high value: FIONx fabric is soft, stretchy, moisture wicking and anti wrinkle, so it holds up really well to long shifts and frequent washing.
Function: Mock neck that works well with a stethoscope, plus multiple pockets (chest, pen, and side drop pockets) so you are getting a lot of function for a standard scrub top price.
Durable, polished pant
Men’s Pierre FORMx Slim Tapered Scrub Pant – Navy
Why it is high value: FORMx fabric has a more structured, athletic feel with moisture wicking and anti static features, so it looks sharp all day and is very durable.
Function: Slim tapered fit with four secure pockets, including two zipper pockets, so you get secure storage without looking bulky.

Quick comparison

Comfort: Timmons (FIONx) is ultra soft and easy wearing; Pierre (FORMx) feels more compressive and “performance” focused.
Look: Timmons reads like a modern, techy top; Pierre has a clean, jogger adjacent silhouette without elastic cuffs.
Longevity: Both are designed for frequent wash and wear; FORMx feels slightly more structured over time, FIONx stays drapey and soft.

If you want one set that hits value, comfort, and polish, pairing Timmons + Pierre in Navy is a really strong choice. Do you usually prefer joggers or straight/slim pants, and what size do you wear in other brands? I can fine tune from there.
